Complaints

Raising a grievance

If something we have done falls short, write to info.alternatives@platizio.com or call +91 92055 23100, marking it as a grievance. We will acknowledge it and tell you who is handling it.

Complaints about a fund, its manager or an AIF registered with SEBI follow a separate route — those are set out on our regulatory disclosure page, along with the SEBI SCORES details.
